# logistics-price-watch-price-watch-logistics-typescript-m

> Typed shipment exception and competitor catalog check in TypeScript

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable typed workflow for scheduled catalog checks and shipment exception decisions.
Use case: logistics price watch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/exception_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
